name: sim-ws-burst
notes: A market-open burst: three subjects at 50 Hz for one second, 150 updates, against a 250 ms conflator. GENERATED by WP-05's providers/sim/prng.ts, not recorded, and TESTING §8 is the record of why: fixtures/providers/raw/cboe-quote-AAPL.json is a single poll carrying one seqno, so no second observation of any quote source exists on disk and a burst cannot be recorded from it. What IS recorded is the snapshot the burst starts from — px0 330.27, 7585.75 and 17.50 are the current_price of cboe-quote-AAPL.json, cboe-spx and cboe-vix, and the seed 247184634 is hash32 of the AAPL capture's requestKey (providers/sim/prng.ts), so the whole path is derived from the fixtures and from nothing else. This session proves BUS-03/BUS-04 on a replay: 150 applied changes leave as a handful of batch frames, and the last value of every field is the value that goes out.
